title: Get Account Operation
description: Read this caller's local operation record; never dispatch or retry it.

outputSchema.description: Account operation result. status/stage are for internal reconciliation, not user-facing open-success/failure badges. Report the separate autofill receipt; a page being open never proves fill or sign-in.

autofill.description: Separate sign-in receipt: the DSphere account manager signs in on the opened page. Query accounts.operations.get with operationId while running; unknown must not be replayed. succeeded: the sign-in form was sent and the page no longer asks to sign in. skipped with already-signed-in, no-sign-in-form or site-unreachable (the tab shows the browser's error page): nothing was typed.

state.description: Where the page stands on its way to the signed-in application. loading: no web document yet. sign-in-required: the sign-in monitor of the browser finds a sign-in or verification wall; the person signs in: read the page (DSphere shows them the sign-in), then dsagent.page.wait until authentication-cleared. signed-in: the monitor checked the application page, found no wall, and the page shows a signed-in account. unknown: no wall, but no signed-in account shows either (an error page, a challenge step, a page still drawing): read the page. unchecked: the application page is open and the monitor could not check it yet; read the page.
